summary: A poetry sharing platform where only the owner can upload, edit, and manage content (poems and collections), while public users can view, download, like, and comment on poems
architectural_notes: Admin access control: Only owner can upload/edit/delete poems and manage collections
Public users have read-only access: view, download, like, and comment
Frontend route guards redirect non-admin users from /admin/* routes
Backend validates admin principal ID for all create/update/delete operations
known_issues: Non-admin users can currently access /admin/add-poem and upload content

existing_features.title: Add frontend route guards to all /admin/* routes (including /admin/add-poem, /admin/collections, and admin panel) that check if the authenticated user is admin and redirect non-admin users to the home page with an informative message
Hide or disable admin navigation links (Add Poem, Collections, Admin Panel) in the header Layout component for non-admin users so only the owner sees these navigation options

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement admin-only access control for upload, edit, delete, and collection management
Protect all /admin/* routes with authentication checks
Register owner's principal ID as admin in backend
Redirect non-admin users attempting to access admin routes to home page

Implement backend admin authorization system that registers the owner's Principal ID as the sole admin and validates admin status for all create, update, and delete operations on poems and collections
Ensure public users retain full access to view poems, download poems, like poems, and comment on poems without any restrictions
